show.title: Husband Honored, Wife Esteemed
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/VPC4Fr
show.description: The story follows a well-regarded scholar and his talented wife who navigate the challenges of the imperial court, using their intelligence and mutual respect to overcome political strife and conspiracies. It's a tale of a loving, equal partnership where both spouses value each other's contributions in upholding their family's honor.
